profile_text.body:
OctoAI is listed as a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, USA, with its website at octo.ai. No products are tracked for the company, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded against it. A Washington law exposure entry is recorded with a count of 114.

The text associated with the company's web address is NVIDIA material rather than OctoAI material. In it, NVIDIA describes itself as the inventor of the GPU and a driver of advances in AI, HPC, gaming, creative design, autonomous vehicles, and robotics, and says it created the world's fastest supercomputer and largest gaming platform. The text names NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, NeMo Switchyard, RTX, DLSS 4, GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, Jetson, and Isaac, and mentions Perplexity's local agent supporting Windows RTX PCs.

The same text states that Deci was acquired by NVIDIA Corporation of Santa Clara, CA in May 2024 and was dissolved as a separate corporate entity. Nothing in the material describes OctoAI's own products or business.
